content.comment_body: Hello Expert, Could you explain how the maximum expansion module is connected to [product_name] ([article_no])? Additionally, which [document] provides details on this topic?
Hi, You will find all the answers in the [product_name] manual, specifically in Chapter 2.

Thank you, [user_name]. I checked the manual and learned that only one AO (analog output expansion module) can be used with [product_name]. I need four AO, but [product_name] isn't compatible. Can you clarify this for me? Also, I want to display logging data in Excel format on a PC for four AI and four AO values (maximum eight data points). Using this [product_name], what economical OPC client would allow logging and display in Excel format on a PC?

Hello, You are correct: [product_name] supports only two AQ, so you would need two [product_name] [version_no] devices to achieve four AQ. Perhaps [product_name] [version_no] series could be a more suitable option for your requirements. Could you provide more details about your logging needs?
We need to log data from four AI and four AO channels in Excel format on one PC from the CPU ([product_name]). Which software would be appropriate for logging these eight data points in a PC?

In [product_name] software, press CTRL+H to select hardware. After choosing your [product_name], you will find extensive information about its specifications, including maximum I/O, digital/analog channels, blocks, and more.
A new question by [user_name] has been moved to a separate thread titled 'Maximum expansion module connect to [product_name] [version_no]'. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Participants are exploring methods to increase the analog output capability of their [product_name] system and facing hardware limitations that restrict the number of supported AO modules. They are also seeking straightforward solutions for logging AI and AO data in Excel, emphasizing the need for simple export options and compatible software tools. The conversation highlights ongoing questions about expansion and ease of data logging.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking to connect four analog output modules to the [product_name] and expects precise documentation about expansion capabilities. They also wish to easily log a limited set of AI and AO data from the system to an Excel file on their PC using cost-effective or compatible software.
